scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance is rooted in Swedish folk traditions, taking its name from the concept of throwing or flinging ("släng").
It spans regions from Östergötland and Värmland to northern Sweden, maintaining historical ties to Nordic dance families like the polska and related Norwegian forms.

Beats 1, 2, and 3 have almost equal stress and length, reflecting the precise rhythm of the dance steps.
